required_fixes: R1 — apps/desktop/src/v2/wizard/wizard.tsx:159–165, 323–343: Cancel can stall when the draft snapshot arrives before the pending beginTenantSetup receipt. An independent production-Wizard probe observed only beginTenantSetup, no discard and no close, with Discarding… disabled after both events settled. Make creation settlement advance cancellation regardless of receipt/snapshot ordering. Acceptance: separately flush snapshot-before-receipt and receipt-before-snapshot cases; both discard the observed draft exactly once and close after confirmed discard without needing an unrelated revision.

R2 — apps/desktop/src/v2/wizard/wizard.tsx:315–324, 352–355: An unknown discard outcome leaves cancelState=discarding and supplies no Retry. If the draft remains present, Cancel stays disabled and Escape/scrim requests are ignored indefinitely. Reproduced with an unknown discard followed by a snapshot retaining the draft: one dispatch, zero closes and no Retry control. Preserve the unconfirmed status while offering explicit recovery using the current draft context; do not silently replay. Acceptance: cover both unknown-discard outcomes—draft gone closes, draft retained permits an operator-triggered retry that can discard and close.
